title: monolithic-dev-harness tracker manifest (trackers/<name>/tracker.json)
description: What a tracker is. Its folder also holds adapter.py, which exports adapter(context) -> TrackerOps.

docs.description: Where the provider documents the behaviour this manifest relies on.

connection.description: How the gateway reaches the provider. In args, {<setting>} is a value from settings.json, {plugin_root} and {repo} are paths.

settings.description: Values the repository gives in settings.json tracker.values.

kinds.description: The provider type for each harness work kind; each names an artifact.

states.description: The provider state for each harness state.

artifacts.description: The provider's work item types and which types each may contain.

tools.description: Provider tool names the adapter calls, by harness operation.

pattern.description: A regular expression for one id, as the provider accepts it.

branch_key.description: A regular expression for {key} in a branch name, with a named group 'id' holding the id.

mention.description: Regular expressions for text the provider turns into a link; {id} stands for one id.

mentions_link.description: Whether a mention in text or a commit message links the item.

writes.description: Host-visible MCP tools that change the tracker; they need an open approval.

server.description: Text the MCP server name contains; empty when the tracker has no host-visible server.

tools.description: Tool names; * matches any run of characters.

planning.description: What the tracker's planning operations (read_iteration, iteration_items) read. A skill fetches each reply through the host's tools and hands them over by key; a tracker that reads its own files lists none.

description.description: Which provider tool to call and with what, in words a skill can follow.
